items.title: Breaking: Former Melbourne organised crime kingpin sentenced to life in Iraq prison
items.description: Kazem Hamad, a former Melbourne organised crime kingpin who was deported to Iraq in 2023, has been sentenced to life in jail by an Iraqi court after being convicted of drug trafficking.

items.title: US pharma giant to pay out $7.9 billion over baby powder lawsuits
items.description: A US pharmaceutical company will pay $7.9 billion to settle thousands of lawsuits that claim its baby powder caused ovarian cancer.

items.title: Meta tells Indigenous inquiry it has no content moderators in Australia
items.description: Meta officials have told a racism inquiry they are "not aware" whether any of their content moderators are Indigenous.

items.title: Australian-founded restaurant at centre of South Korean court case over ant garnish
items.description: Seoul prosecutors have alleged Evett in Seoul's Gangnam district served ants illegally imported from Thailand and the US in violation of food safety regulations.

items.title: A rogue AI just gave us a warning. Australia isn't prepared
items.description: Far-fetched scenarios about artificial intelligence became more realistic last week when an OpenAI model hacked another company.

items.title: Reserve Bank governor warns world facing increased supply shocks
items.description: The Reserve Bank governor says the world has become more shock-prone in recent years, and the latest oil spike is a complication for the central bank's monetary policy.

items.title: Rabbi supports stopping hospital staff from wearing Israeli, Palestinian pins
items.description: Jewish patients requested their religion be removed from their hospital admission information following allegations nurses made menacing comments about Israeli patients, the royal commission on antisemitism has heard.

items.title: ICAC told of right-wing faction's plan to 'shake down Angus for 10k'
items.description: The NSW corruption watchdog has heard claims senior Liberal figures discussed seeking financial backing for the party's right-wing faction from now-federal Opposition Leader Angus Taylor.

items.title: Origin Energy believes 900,000 customers' data accessed in breach
items.description: Origin Energy says it started reviewing a "potential security threat" early this month but deemed it not credible, before new information indicated a breach.

items.title: Live: Ben Carroll sworn in as Victorian premier, immediately calls construction royal commission
items.description: Ben Carroll has been appointed premier of Victoria. Follow our live coverage.

items.title: President Trump Announces U.S. Military Airstrike in Venezuela
items.description: President Trump states the U.S. military conducted its first known airstrike inside Venezuela targeting a dock where drugs were allegedly loaded onto boats[1][2][4].

items.title: Trump Meets Netanyahu at Mar-a-Lago for Gaza Ceasefire Phase Two Talks
items.description: President Trump met with Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu to discuss advancing phase two of the Gaza ceasefire, including reconstruction and responses to Iran[1][4].

items.title: Feds Launch Massive Taxpayer Fraud Probe in Minnesota After Viral Video
items.description: Federal agencies including DHS, FBI, and ICE investigate $110 million in suspected fraud at Minnesota child care centers following a viral YouTube video[3].

items.title: Americans Express Widespread Opposition to AI Data Centers
items.description: Public backlash against AI infrastructure data centers grows, with protests and demands for bans influencing Democratic Party strategies for future elections[3].

items.title: Elon Musk's Humanoid Robot Vision: China Poised to Lead Production
items.description: China prioritizes humanoid robots in tech race with U.S., ramping up production while warning of industry bubble and potential bottlenecks[3].

items.title: Trump-Putin Call Amid Ukraine-Russia Tensions Over Peace Plan
items.description: President Trump spoke with Putin amid ongoing Ukraine conflict, with Russia reevaluating peace plan tenets after Ukrainian denials[1].

items.title: Democratic Gubernatorial Candidates in Wisconsin Focus on Inflation and Trump
items.description: Seven Democrats vying for Wisconsin governor blame economic issues on Trump and emphasize affordability ahead of 2026 primary[3].
